correctness.rationale: Six mutually exclusive and exhaustive classes follow from observed-core support and at most one untouched core–leaf pair in the part needing propagation; the unique-neighbor condition is handled in both directions, including p=q=2. Each class has a directly reconstructed weight polynomial. Direct adjacency-based brute-force verification matched all 173,312 subsets on eight boards; an independent exact symbolic computation checked minimum coefficients across 361 parameter pairs. These finite checks are corroborative, while the class argument proves the quantified theorem.

value.rationale: The one-leaf corona is an explicitly natural boundary left distinct by the foundational power-domination-polynomial study. A six-class structural criterion yields a full polynomial for all set sizes in an infinite two-parameter family, not merely a known single minimum. Exact optimal PMU-placement multiplicities vary sharply at p=2 and p=q=2, motivating the specific invariant and boundary.
